statement_summary: Security and compliance lead designated in writing
Annual risk assessment with SP 800-30; risks owned and treated
Risk acceptance authority; unsafe or misbranded food risks never accepted
Proportionate sanctions; good-faith reporting protected
Vendor list and security terms for vendors that reach machines or records
Annual independent assessment
Retention of security documents; FSIS retention for food safety records
Annual policy review; policies available to staff
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Named accounts; no shared logins; entries under own account
Least privilege; two named administrators; no vendor default accounts
MFA for suite, accounting, payroll, portals, and every administrator login including MSP-held logins
Leaver checklist including PIN and shared password changes
Monthly account reconciliation against roster and vendor list
Office lock after 10 minutes; floor devices locked at shift end
Sealed emergency administrator credentials
Vendor remote access off by default; supervised and logged sessions; no unattended tools
Password length; no passwords on equipment; yearly Wi-Fi change
Change control for cycles, formulations, line settings, and labels with HACCP reassessment decision
Use systems for company work; change only approved settings
No Restricted information in personal accounts or public AI tools
Never share passwords, PINs, or MFA codes
Training at hire and yearly; phishing simulations
Report suspected incidents at once
Signed policy acknowledgment
Ransomware runbook kept and printed
Report within 1 hour; product-affecting issues also to the Production Supervisor
Log every incident
Hold and review product affected by an incident; no shipment without reviewed records
FSIS District Office notice within 24 hours; recall procedure
Unexplained setting changes treated as possible tampering
Insurer hotline before outside firms
Ransom payment only with approvals and OFAC check
Meet notification deadlines in the P08 matrix
Vendor incident reports logged and handled
Restart only after settings compared and Production Supervisor sign-off
Annual tabletop; lessons learned within 30 days
Three classification levels with integrity emphasis
Encryption in transit; encrypted and locked mobile devices
Restricted information only in approved, restricted locations
Inventory of devices, controllers, services, remote paths, and Restricted data
Integrity of food safety records and settings; offline approved copies; monthly comparison
Approved AI tools only
90-day immutable backups; quarterly restore tests including cook-log exports
Retention periods for CCP, SSOP, and recall records
New tools and vendors approved before Restricted data or machine access
Wipe or destroy devices and controllers with records
